import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style='whitegrid')

# Create a figure and axes
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))

# Plot boxplots for transaction amounts categorized by transaction type
sns.boxplot(data=data, x='transaction_type', y='amount', hue='is_fraud')

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Transaction Amount Distribution by Type and Fraud Status')
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Transaction Amount')
plt.legend(title='Is Fraud')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
